name: iHermes
notes: Hosted personal assistant over iMessage and SMS built on Nous Research's open-source Hermes Agent: connects Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Notion, Slack and Linear, remembers context, turns repeated workflows into skills, proactive and scheduled texts on the paid tier. Free tier with no card; Plus $19/mo; Teams custom. No named company, founder or social handles; contact is dan@ihermes.co. Requested via the form (issue #319).
tagline: A hosted Hermes Agent you text on iMessage
